job.title: [Post] We're Hiring: SFCC Architect | 10+ Years of Experience WillWare Technologies is looking fo…

tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Java, Spring & REST APIs | 5+ years e-commerce platform delivery
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering enterprise e-commerce platforms, specializing in SAP Commerce Cloud architecture, API design, integration with PIM/ERP/MDM, microservices and cloud deployments. Proven record of solution design, agile delivery, and bridging business and IT to drive scalable, high-performance online commerce.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SFCC Architect
cover_en.hook: I am excited by WillWare Technologies’ focus on cutting-edge commerce platforms. With over five years delivering large-scale SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in e-commerce architecture, API design and integration. My track record of leading technical delivery and bridging business and IT aligns with the strategic vision of an SFCC Architect.

bullets.label: E-Commerce Architecture
bullets.text: Designed end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud architectures, defining data models, catalog structures and promotion logic that scale globally, directly applicable to SFCC solution design.

bullets.label: API Design & Integration
bullets.text: Built and exposed OCC REST web services and integrated PIM/ERP/MDM pipelines, delivering robust headless APIs and data synchronization—core capabilities required for SFCC integration projects.

bullets.label: Cloud & DevOps Delivery
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD pipelines on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2) with Docker and Kubernetes, ensuring reliable cloud deployments and rapid release cycles, matching SFCC cloud-native expectations.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Leadership
bullets.text: Collaborated with international stakeholders to analyse requirements, write user stories and functional specs, and guide junior developers, providing the cross-functional leadership essential for an architect role.

cover_en.logistics: Karlsruhe, Germany. Valid German residence permit. Serving notice until 15 December 2026, earliest start 16 December 2026. Available for interview at your convenience.

tailoring.why_company: WillWare Technologies is renowned for delivering innovative, high-performance commerce solutions that enable brands to stay ahead in a fast-moving digital market. I am drawn to your commitment to cutting-edge technology and continuous improvement, and I want to apply my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to help shape robust, scalable SFCC architectures that drive customer success and business growth.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to bring my proven e-commerce architecture and integration experience to WillWare Technologies, helping build next-generation SFCC solutions that deliver measurable business value.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years of e-commerce architecture experience. I’m eager to discuss how my background can support WillWare Technologies’ SFCC initiatives. Let’s connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for SFCC Architect – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body: Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the SFCC Architect position at WillWare Technologies. With 5+ years leading SAP Commerce Cloud projects for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring extensive e-commerce architecture, API integration and cloud delivery experience. I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and will be available from 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to your team.
